messages:
Zoe: Tiny ask — I'm curating a 'midnight double feature' list: 2 short films (each <=45min), one short novella (<200p), and one single-song mood match. Drop one of each if you want. I'll stitch into a PDF/playlist. No long threads pls :P
Miguel: Film 1: 'La Jetée' (28m). Film 2: 'Un Chien Andalou' (21m). Novella: 'The Metamorphosis' (Kafka, ~100p). Song: 'The Great Gig in the Sky' (live vibes).
Priya: Love La Jetée. I'll add Film 1: 'A Trip to the Moon' (1902 short, ~15m, so technically.) Film 2: 'Meshes of the Afternoon' (14m). Novella: 'Of Mice and Men' (short but heavy). Song: 'Nineteen Hundred and Eighty-Five' for the oddly dramatic late-night energy.
Arjun: Film 1: 'Night and Fog' (31m). Film 2: 'The Red Balloon' (34m) — whimsical palette shift. Novella: 'The Death of Ivan Ilyich' (~120p) for the existential punch. Song: 'Moon River' (mellow)
Cassie: Going very different: Film 1: 'F for Fake' (extracts are great but full is long — recommend the 37m montage). Film 2: 'The House is Black' (22m). Novella: 'Breakfast at Tiffany's' (Capote) — short and sharp. Song: 'I Put a Spell on You' (creepy comfort).
